Commit-only DiffTest or executable-region protection implemented and independently exercised; finite scope documented.
Real train cycles and two256x32 flop-memory synthesis. Separate fixed Nangate45 mapping/STA analyzed; transition violations explicitly prevent a qualified frequency claim.
One-cycle IFU backend, two clocks per instruction, four-state cycle controls and full program regressions.
Synchronous LSU, two ordinary/three memory cycles, stable state while waiting and independent memory/ISA checks.
VALID request/response ownership and independent transaction counts; no retirement before completion.
Fixed5/10/20 latency plus recorded LFSR seeds and independent request delay controls.
READY/VALID payload stability under request and response backpressure; waveform and actual failure controls.
Arm IHI0022H A3 handshake/dependency rules checked; Xbar READY dependency fixed with registered AR buffering and dedicated rejecting mutant.
Five-channel Lite adapters, independent AW/W, stalled responses, read-only IFU; RT-Thread is a separate prerequisite-dependent C5 integration.
Owner locked to response completion;64 contended grants in sustained two-master demand, wrong-route/data/fixed-priority mutants rejected.
CPU+adapters+arbiter synthesis and complete train cycles; external DPI RAM excluded from area. Explicit IO STA and unqualified Nangate transition results retained.
RTL UART prints exactly once per accepted strobed write; Xbar boundaries, errors, reset and concurrent AR/AW/W tested.
RTL64-bit mtime low-read high-latch rollover tested; actual AM conversion, measured calibration and default-driver1/2/3-second output.

limits: Finite functional simulation, not arbitrary-input or unbounded proof.
Icarus fabric attempt TIMEOUT retained; successful fabric tests are timed Verilator. Stage1/2 CPU and device tests are separate four-state Icarus evidence.
Nangate45 default-ABC baseline has max-transition violations; no qualified maximum frequency or reliable performance speedup claim. Assessment task completed with the failures reported.
Nangate45/OpenSTA is a declared alternative flow, not a claim of exact legacy yosys-sta/iSTA/DELAY4 reproduction.
Single2KiB synthesized memories cannot hold train; cycles measured in128MiB simulator. External DPI memory excluded from AXI CPU area.
Train disables DiffTest/trace, keeping original validators; test scale and ISA regressions use independent NEMU.
CLINT wall calibration depends on host load and workload; no physical clock measurement.
C5 full-SoC/RT-Thread and all B work are not covered.
